source_text: Plura restant de Balaam et asina eius. Tractatus ecclesiae temporalis non omnia verba discutere potest; quae inquisitione digna repetimus.
pass_a_gloss: Many remain concerning Balaam and donkey his. Treatise of-church temporal not all words to-discuss is-able; which by-inquiry worthy we-repeat.
pass_b_english: Much remains on [[Balaam and his donkey >> Bible:Numbers 22:21-35]]. A timed church sermon cannot weigh every word; we return to what still needs inquiry.
